values: Model A: complete fictional materials

Model A is an editorially designed fictional crew-record verification exercise observing only data attribution, missing items, and modification trails. R3: T-A / V-A / inspection incomplete / stretcher-lock defect awaiting professional recheck / handover J3 / recording time 10 minutes.

entries.answer: The O*NET question asks how much education new hires need to perform this occupation's work: 36% answered a post-secondary non-degree certificate, 24% a high school diploma or equivalent, and 15% less than high school; this is not the incumbent education composition or a statutory entry threshold. The Job Zone 1–2 description of several days to one year of training is a group-level general description and must not be taken as this occupation's uniform training period. Mainland China's Pre-hospital Medical Emergency Care Management Measures Articles 19–20 distinguish physicians, nurses, and medical rescue attendants; medical rescue attendants may perform prescribed auxiliary work such as on-scene initial first aid and transport escort. Article 19 as originally written mentions the national vocational qualification and municipal emergency-center pre-job assessment requirements; the vocational-qualification evaluation system has since been reformed, and the current form of proof must be checked with competent authorities and regular evaluation institutions — the article must not be turned into a universal certificate requirement for all drivers or stretcher bearers. The 2020 guidance, item (Eight), separately calls for strengthening the business training and assessment of dispatchers, drivers, and stretcher bearers. Driving positions also require a driver's license for the matching vehicle type; driving experience, health, probation, and refresher conditions are checked item by item against the specific position. Regional example: the Jinan Municipal Health Commission's reply of 2026-07-06 states that in that city drivers are hired by medical institutions, which then arrange unified pre-job training and assessment, and individuals cannot apply on their own for the city's ambulance-driver work qualification certificate; the driver's license must match the vehicle and have at least three years of driving experience. This applies only to that city's statement and cannot be extrapolated to a nationally uniform driving-experience requirement or application method.

subject.summary: Ambulance drivers and attendants drive or assist in driving ambulances, move patients, keep the vehicle and equipment ready, and record handovers. The US 53-3011.00 excludes EMTs, but the tasks include basic first aid within the trained scope; qualifications and authorities for Chinese driving, stretcher, and medical-rescue positions must be checked separately.
